A map that holds a list of three records, each with a name, a status and, for some, a list of files and an owner. Awk programs beside the calls read it through tree.awk. renamed.awk prints every record under other names, with a member copied as it is and a member that is missing copied as a null. summary.awk reads a second document given with --with and two values given with --arg, and prints plain text. kinds.awk prints what each document is: a scalar, an empty list, a map. shouted.awk calls a function that the library shout.awk defines, loaded with --load. The calls also show what the verb refuses: a program or a library that is not a file, no document, an option it does not know, an option with nothing after it and a name that no variable can have.
